svg.text: TAMR-DTI architecture: target-aware drug conformers and ligand-conditioned protein refinement
concat + light gate -> drug tokens D, context d_g
refine P, then match D and P
1. ProtBERT creates P0 before conformer selection; P0 + energy scores k conformers.
2. Weighted conformers are fused with 1D/2D drug tokens; the resulting d_g FiLM-modulates protein refinement.
